newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait crown prince leaves hospital, feeling well.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait crown prince leaves hospital, feeling well.

text.p: Kuwait's crown prince said on Thursday he was in "good health" after spending two days in hospital.

Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah, who was rushed to hospital on Tuesday evening after fainting due to what local newspapers said was internal bleeding, was shown on state television leaving the hospital.
"I am, thank God, in good health," said Sheikh Saad, who has been prime minister since 1978. "Thank God who bestowed on me a fast recovery in order to resume my work."

Sheikh Saad, who was born in 1930, left accompanied by ministers and other state officials. The emiri court on Tuesday issued a statement saying Sheikh Saad was taken to hospital after a "sudden indisposition".
Kuwait, a founder of the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries, produces about two million barrels of oil per day. It controls 10 percent of the world's proven oil reserves.
